tasks.description: Upgrade eShopOnWeb (ApplicationCore, Infrastructure, PublicApi, Web, BlazorShared, BlazorAdmin, and associated test projects) from .NET 8.0 to .NET 10.0
tasks.reason: The solution currently targets .NET 8.0. Upgrading to .NET 10.0, the current Long Term Support (LTS) release, ensures continued long-term support, access to the latest performance and security improvements, and full compatibility with current Azure SDKs and tooling.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade the centrally managed target framework from net8.0 to net10.0 across all projects in the solution (ApplicationCore, Infrastructure, PublicApi, Web, BlazorShared, BlazorAdmin, UnitTests, IntegrationTests, FunctionalTests, PublicApiIntegrationTests). Update NuGet package references to versions compatible with .NET 10, address any breaking API or behavioral changes introduced between .NET 8 and .NET 10, and ensure the solution builds successfully with all existing tests passing.
